title: Space Guardians
tagline: Satellite Secured Access Recovery - A MetaMask Guardian management system using Snaps
description:
In web3, the “Forgot my password” button doesn’t exist in a normal way

Existing schemes are vulnerable to
1. Guardians’ security can get compromized
2. Notification - reduce collusion event likelihood

We developed a security solution for social key recovery schemes MM snaps + Cryptosat satellites

This addresses managing of notifications and audit-trail thus reducing collusion likelihood.
how_its_made:
We've used the MM Snaps framework, Snappy Recovery example by Ziad Saab (https://github.com/ziad-saab/snappy-recovery)


We've integrated it with backend API of Cryptosat satellite's digital twin (lab/test environment) for storage and event auditing.

The repository includes the front end web product and satellites communication backend API 

Front end: https://github.com/cryptosat/satlock
Backend: https://github.com/cryptosat/satlock_api
